text:
maria: Quick heads-up — we're scheduling a short maintenance window for eu-west1 serving nodes tomorrow (03:00-03:30 UTC). Expected impact: brief request queuing for non‑critical background jobs. No planned data migration. Posting drafts below for status page + customer copy. Pls review and ack.

sanjay: ack, I'm oncall that window. I'll own the pager and watch the drain. Can you confirm if autoscale will be disabled?

maria: @sanjay yes, autoscale will be temporarily set to min=1 for the window to ensure controlled drain. Runbook step 2 covers fallback routes.

oncall-bot: Reminder: create incident bridge 3921001234 and tag with #maintenance #eu-west1 — bridge URL: https://bridge.example.com/3921001234

maria: Draft statuspage (short):
```
We will perform a planned maintenance in eu-west1 on 2026-04-20 03:00–03:30 UTC. During this window some background requests may be queued for up to ~90s. Core API / critical serving should remain within SLOs. We will update here if timelines change.
```

jordan: Suggest adding an ETA for a post-maint update (e.g., +15m) so customers know when to expect closure message.

maria: Good call. Updated: add "We will post a follow-up update within 15 minutes after completion."

maria: Draft customer notification (email/webhook copy):
```
Subject: Planned maintenance: brief serving window in eu-west1 (2026-04-20)
Hi — we're scheduling a short maintenance window in eu-west1 on 2026-04-20 from 03:00–03:30 UTC. Most customers will not see disruption; some background or low-priority requests may be delayed by up to ~90s. No data migrations or schema changes. If you have region-specific latency requirements, consider routing to eu-central1 during the window. We will post a completion update within 15 minutes after the window ends. Reach out to support if this conflicts with your maintenance windows.
Regards, Redwood Inference Ops
```

eva: Copy reads well. Maybe add a link to the runbook for customers on Dedicated? Might be overkill in the initial notice.

maria: I think keep initial notice concise. We'll include runbook link in a follow-up if a customer asks.

sanjay: Oncall checklist for the window: 1) Create bridge (done) 2) Lock autoscale 3) Start drain on non-critical pools 4) Monitor latency/5xx dashboard panels 5) Post completion update. I'll paste commands when we start.

maria: Command snippets (for ops runbook):
```
# set autoscale min
redwoodctl autoscale set --region eu-west1 --min 1
# kick drain
redwoodctl nodes drain --region eu-west1 --pool background
# sanity check
redwoodctl health check --region eu-west1 --filters serving,latency
```

oncall-bot: Pager note created for @sanjay at 03:00 UTC. If no ack within 5m, escalate to @jordan.

jordan: I'll be second-line during the window and available on phone.

maria: If everything looks good we'll post the status page notice at T-6 hours and the customer email at T-3 hours. Posting schedule: 
- statuspage: 2026-04-19 21:00 UTC (T-6h)
- customer email: 2026-04-20 00:00 UTC (T-3h)
- maintenance start: 2026-04-20 03:00 UTC

maria: Anyone object to T-6/T-3 schedule?

eva: No objections from me.

sanjay: sounds good. I'll update the runbook with the command snippets and set up the bridge pins.

statusbot: Scheduled post queued: statuspage notice at 2026-04-19T21:00:00Z. Notification will include the follow-up promise.

maria: Thanks all — I'll upload the final copies to the comms folder and ping #announcements for publishing. Will also post an internal template for the post-completion message to this thread for quick copy/paste.

maria: Post-completion template:
```
Maintenance complete: eu-west1 (2026-04-20 03:00–03:25 UTC)
We completed the planned maintenance ahead of schedule. Services have returned to normal. Any residual errors should resolve within a few minutes; please reopen if you see persistent issues. Full notes: <link-to-runbook-logs>
```

sanjay: Posting notes: we completed drain step early and saw a single 5xx spike (12m) on a background job; mitigated by rollback of batch worker config. No customer-facing impact observed. Will append logs to the runbook.

maria: Perfect. I'll close out by posting the post-completion message and sending the customer follow-up. Closing thread prep. :thumbsup:
